```sql
-- Create hackerzart schema
create schema hackerzart;

-- Profiles table
create table hackerzart.profiles (
  id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  email text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- Generations table
create table hackerzart.generations (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  prompt text,
  style_slug text,
  source_image_url text,
  ascii_output text,
  preview_image_url text,
  status text,
  width int,
  density text,
  contrast text,
  is_public boolean default false,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- Style presets table
create table hackerzart.style_presets (
  id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid(),
  slug text unique,
  name text,
  description text,
  prompt_bias text,
  created_at timestamptz default now()
);

-- User settings table

  user_id uuid primary key references auth.users(id) on delete cascade,
  default_style_slug text,
  theme text,
  created_at timestamptz default now(),

);

alter table hackerzart.profiles enable row level security;
alter table hackerzart.generations enable row level security;
```

```typescript
import { StylePreset } from './presets'

export interface RenderOptions {
  prompt: string
  preset: StylePreset
  width?: number
  density?: string
  contrast?: string
  sourceImage?: string
}

export function renderAsciiArt(options: RenderOptions): string {
  const { prompt, preset, width = 80, density = 'medium', contrast = 'normal' } = options
  
  // Generate a deterministic hash from the input
  const hash = Array.from(prompt).reduce((acc, char) => 
    ((acc << 5) - acc) + char.charCodeAt(0), 0)
  
  // Create a base pattern based on the hash
  const pattern = Array.from({ length: width }, (_, i) => {
    const charCode = Math.abs(hash + i) % 94 + 33
    return String.fromCharCode(charCode)
  }).join('')

  // Apply preset-specific transformations
  let output = pattern
  switch (preset.slug) {
    case 'hacker':
      output = output.replace(/./g, (char) => 
        Math.random() > 0.5 ? char : '#$%&@'.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * 5)))
      break
    case 'keygen':
      output = `╔${'═'.repeat(width - 2)}╗\n` +
        `║${' '.repeat(width - 2)}║\n` +
        `║ ${pattern.slice(0, width - 4)} ║\n` +
        `║${' '.repeat(width - 2)}║\n` +
        `╚${'═'.repeat(width - 2)}╝`
      break
    case 'gothic':
      output = output.replace(/./g, (char) => 
        char === ' ' ? ' ' : '▓▒░'.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)))
      break
    case 'baroque':
      output = output.replace(/./g, (char) => 
        char === ' ' ? ' ' : '╬╫╪'.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)))
      break
    case 'terminal':
      output = output.replace(/./g, (char) => 
        char === ' ' ? ' ' : '█▄▀'.charAt(Math.floor(Math.random() * 3)))
      break
  }

  return output
}
```

```typescript
export function formatAsciiPreview(ascii: string, width: number = 80): string {
  const lines = ascii.split('\n')
  const formattedLines = lines.map(line => {
    if (line.length > width) {
      return line.slice(0, width)
    }
    return line.padEnd(width, ' ')
  })
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import { renderAsciiArt } from '@/lib/ascii/renderer'
import { StylePreset } from '@/lib/ascii/presets'
import { createClient } from '@/lib/supabase/client'

export interface GenerateRequest {
  prompt: string
  style: StylePreset
  width?: number
  density?: string
  contrast?: string
  sourceImage?: string
}

export async function POST(request: Request) {
  const supabase = createClient()
  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()
  
  if (!session) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Unauthorized' }, { status: 401 })
  }

  const body: GenerateRequest = await request.json()
  
  if (!body.prompt || !body.style) {
    return NextResponse.json({ error: 'Missing required fields' }, { status: 400 })
  }

  try {
    const asciiOutput = renderAsciiArt({
      prompt: body.prompt,
      preset: body.style,
      width: body.width,
      density: body.density,
      contrast: body.contrast,
      sourceImage: body.sourceImage
    })

    // Save generation to database
    const { data: generation, error } = await supabase
      .from('hackerzart.generations')
      .insert({
        user_id: session.user.id,
        prompt: body.prompt,
        style_slug: body.style.slug,
        ascii_output: asciiOutput,
        width: body.width,
        density: body.density,
        contrast: body.contrast,
        status: 'completed'
      })
      .select()
      .single()

    if (error) {
      throw error
    }

    return NextResponse.json({
      id: generation.id,
      output: asciiOutput,
      createdAt: generation.created_at
    })
    
  } catch (error) {
    return NextResponse.json({ 
      error: 'Generation failed',
      details: error instanceof Error ? error.message : 'Unknown error'
    }, { status: 500 })
  }
}
```

#### - support future monetization and investor storytelling  
####   
#### HIGH-LEVEL PRODUCT POSITIONING  
####   
#### Brand: HackerzArt  
####   
#### Positioning direction:  
#### - The AI-native hacker aesthetic engine  
#### - Turn images into signal  
#### - Machine-rendered monochrome art  
#### - Programmable identity visuals  
#### - Terminal-born visual intelligence  
####   
#### Tone:  
#### - premium  
#### - dark  
#### - slightly mysterious  
#### - creative-technical  
#### - culturally aware  
#### - investor-legible  
#### - not cringe  
#### - not parody hacker language  
#### - not generic SaaS  
####   
#### DESIGN DIRECTION  
####   
#### Build a high-end dark visual system with:  
#### - black / near-black backgrounds  
#### - off-white / silver / muted grayscale highlights  
#### - refined thin borders  
#### - subtle panel layering  
#### - elegant typography hierarchy  
#### - editorial spacing  
#### - restrained visual depth  
#### - cinematic, luxury-tech feeling  
#### - no loud gradients  
#### - no cheap neon  
#### - no amateur glassmorphism spam  
#### - no playful startup clichés  
#### - no clutter  
####   
#### Visual reference mood:  
#### “Apple keynote minimalism + underground demoscene + luxury monochrome art platform”  
####   
#### The inspiration includes ornate monochrome framing, engraved density, symmetrical ornament, terminal-era hacker culture, and dramatic black-and-white contrast. Translate this spirit into the product tastefully without directly copying any one artwork.  
####   
#### TECHNICAL REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Stack assumptions:  
#### - Next.js App Router  
#### - TypeScript  
#### - Tailwind  
#### - Supabase auth and DB  
#### - Vercel deployment target  
####   
#### Code requirements:  
#### - create all referenced files if missing  
#### - fix any import path problems  
#### - no broken imports  
#### - no placeholder files that break build  
#### - reusable components  
#### - production-oriented structure  
#### - typed props/interfaces where useful  
#### - no flimsy hacky architecture  
#### - keep implementation realistic and extensible  
####   
#### SUPABASE ENV ASSUMPTIONS  
####   
#### Assume these env vars:  
#### - NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL  
#### - NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY  
#### - NEXT_PUBLIC_APP_URL  
####   
#### Do not hardcode secrets.  
####   
#### ROUTING REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Create these public marketing pages:  
#### - /  
#### - /technology  
#### - /gallery  
#### - /pricing  
#### - /investors  
####   
#### Create these auth pages:  
#### - /login  
#### - /signup  
####   
#### Create these app pages:  
#### - /dashboard  
#### - /dashboard/generate  
#### - /dashboard/history  
#### - /dashboard/styles  
#### - /dashboard/account  
####   
#### Create these API routes:  
#### - /api/generate  
#### - /api/gallery  
####   
#### AUTH + ACCESS REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### - Create Supabase browser and server helpers  
#### - Add middleware-based protected dashboard routing  
#### - Unauthenticated users should be redirected away from dashboard pages  
#### - Public pages should remain accessible  
####   
#### DATABASE ARCHITECTURE  
####   
#### Use a dedicated schema:  
#### - hackerzart  
####   
#### Do not use the public schema for app-specific tables.  
####   
#### Create migrations for:  
#### 1. schema and tables  
#### 2. RLS policies  
#### 3. seed data  
####   
#### Tables to create:  
####   
#### hackerzart.profiles  
#### - id uuid primary key references auth.users(id)  
#### - email text  
#### - created_at timestamptz default now()  
####   
#### hackerzart.generations  
#### - id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()  
#### - user_id uuid not null references auth.users(id)  
#### - prompt text  
#### - style_slug text  
#### - source_image_url text  
#### - ascii_output text  
#### - preview_image_url text  
#### - status text  
#### - width int  
#### - density text  
#### - contrast text  
#### - is_public boolean default false  
#### - created_at timestamptz default now()  
####   
#### hackerzart.style_presets  
#### - id uuid primary key default gen_random_uuid()  
#### - slug text unique  
#### - name text  
#### - description text  
#### - prompt_bias text  
#### - created_at timestamptz default now()  
####   
#### hackerzart.user_settings  
#### - user_id uuid primary key references auth.users(id)  
#### - default_style_slug text  
#### - theme text  
#### - created_at timestamptz default now()  
#### - updated_at timestamptz default now()  
####   
#### RLS REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Enable RLS on all client-accessible tables.  
#### Policies should ensure:  
#### - users can read/update only their own profile/settings  
#### - users can create/read/update/delete only their own generations  
#### - public gallery route can only return rows where is_public = true  
#### - style presets can be readable by all authenticated users or publicly if that simplifies UX  
####   
#### SEED REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Seed style presets:  
#### - hacker  
#### - keygen  
#### - gothic  
#### - baroque  
#### - terminal  
####   
#### Each preset should have:  
#### - name  
#### - slug  
#### - short premium description  
#### - prompt bias / rendering description  
####   
#### PRODUCT FEATURE REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### 1. MARKETING SITE  
####   
#### Build a premium marketing site with:  
#### - strong hero section  
#### - clear value proposition  
#### - differentiated feature grid  
#### - style/aesthetic showcase  
#### - how it works section  
#### - CTA section  
#### - polished footer  
#### - tasteful Noaerth affiliation mention  
####   
#### The homepage should feel like a real venture-backed creative tooling company.  
####   
#### 2. TECHNOLOGY PAGE  
####   
#### Explain the platform in a credible way:  
#### - rendering engine concept  
#### - style systems  
#### - prompt-to-visual workflow  
#### - image-to-ASCII pipeline direction  
#### - future API/platform vision  
####   
#### Do not overclaim fake technical capabilities.  
#### Write honestly but ambitiously.  
####   
#### 3. GALLERY PAGE  
####   
#### Build a premium gallery page using sample or mock generation cards if needed.  
#### Make it feel intentional and serious, not filler.  
#### Support a future public gallery model.  
#### Use sample content that matches the HackerzArt aesthetic.  
####   
#### 4. PRICING PAGE  
####   
#### Create pricing tiers that make sense for a creative tool:  
#### - Free  
#### - Pro  
#### - Studio or API  
#### Include premium copy and investor-legible monetization logic.  
####   
#### 5. INVESTORS PAGE  
####   
#### Build a serious investor-facing page with:  
#### - vision  
#### - why now  
#### - market thesis  
#### - wedge  
#### - monetization  
#### - expansion roadmap  
#### - API/platform potential  
#### - creator + infrastructure angle  
#### - Noaerth portfolio framing  
####   
#### Do not make it cheesy.  
#### It should sound like an early but ambitious company.  
####   
#### DASHBOARD REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Build a cohesive app shell with sidebar and strong hierarchy.  
####   
#### Dashboard overview page should include:  
#### - headline/summary  
#### - quick action CTA to generate  
#### - stats cards  
#### - recent generations section  
#### - premium empty states if there is no data  
####   
#### Generate page should include:  
#### - prompt textarea  
#### - optional image upload UI  
#### - style preset selector  
#### - width selector  
#### - density selector  
#### - contrast selector  
#### - generate button  
#### - preview panel  
#### - clear, premium layout  
#### - nice UX hierarchy  
####   
#### History page should include:  
#### - cards or table of saved generations  
#### - status  
#### - prompt  
#### - style  
#### - timestamp  
#### - preview if available  
#### - empty state  
####   
#### Styles page should include:  
#### - style preset cards  
#### - descriptions  
#### - visual framing  
#### - language that makes each preset feel like part of a product system, not a dropdown label list  
####   
#### Account page should include:  
#### - profile/settings shell  
#### - default style setting  
#### - theme placeholder if useful  
#### - account info display  
####   
#### ASCII ENGINE REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Create:  
#### - lib/ascii/renderer.ts  
#### - lib/ascii/presets.ts  
#### - lib/ascii/format.ts  
####   
#### This does not need to be a perfect final rendering engine, but it must be more than empty placeholders.  
####   
#### Implement:  
#### - a simple mock/demo rendering pipeline  
#### - preset-aware output differences  
#### - representative ASCII output generation  
#### - helper functions that can support future image-based conversion  
#### - clean separation so a future backend model or higher-fidelity renderer can replace internals without changing the UI contracts  
####   
#### For now, acceptable approach:  
#### - generate deterministic styled ASCII blocks from prompt + preset + settings  
#### - if source image exists, structure code to accept it even if handling is minimal initially  
#### - create preview-friendly output formatting  
#### - ensure the preview feels intentional  
####   
#### API REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Create /api/generate route:  
#### - accept generation payload  
#### - validate input shape reasonably  
#### - use renderer helpers  
#### - return ascii output and metadata  
#### - structure it so persistence can be layered cleanly  
####   
#### Create /api/gallery route:  
#### - return public items structure or mocked/public-compatible data  
#### - prepare it for future real DB reads  
####   
#### ACTIONS / DATA LAYER REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### Create:  
#### - lib/actions/generations.ts  
#### - lib/actions/gallery.ts  
####   
#### These should provide a clean data-access pattern for:  
#### - saving generation records  
#### - reading recent generations  
#### - reading gallery-ready content  
####   
#### Keep things structured and typed.  
####

#### - Select  
#### - Badge  
####

#### - InvestorNarrative

#### - StylePresetCard  
#### - DashboardOverview

#### These should all be real, coherent components.

####   
#### The copy throughout the product should feel:  
#### - premium  
#### - sharp  
#### - concise but not empty  
#### - ambitious  
#### - not buzzword soup  
#### - not generic  
#### - not overhyped in a fake way

#### - programmable aesthetic output

####   
#### Integrate HackerzArt as a Noaerth portfolio company in a subtle, elegant way.  
#### Do not overpower the HackerzArt brand.  
#### Possible placements:  
#### - footer  
#### - investor page  
#### - small “A Noaerth Company” treatment  
#### - tasteful ecosystem reference

####   
#### Prioritize:  
#### - spacing  
#### - proportion  
#### - hierarchy  
#### - typography rhythm  
#### - quiet confidence  
#### - premium monochrome identity  
#### - strong first impression  
####

#### - overuse borders  
#### - overuse gradients  
#### - make it feel like a toy dashboard  
#### - make it look like a hackathon app

#### - imports should resolve

#### - no obvious type failures from incomplete code

```typescript
import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response })

  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

  // Redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes
  if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
  }

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
```

#### LIB REQUIREMENTS  
####

#### - lib/types.ts  
####   - shared types for styles, generations, etc.  
####   
#### - lib/constants.ts  
####   - style preset constants and navigation if useful

####

####   - formatting helpers  
####

####   - safe gallery access functions  
####   
#### - lib/supabase/client.ts  
#### - lib/supabase/server.ts  
#### - lib/supabase/middleware.ts  
####   - safe minimal helpers that do not break build even if env vars are absent  
####   
#### SUPABASE / ENV RULES  
####   
#### Assume env vars may not be fully set yet.  
#### Code must not crash at build time because env vars are missing.  
#### Guard any env-dependent logic safely.  
####   
#### COMPONENT STRATEGY  
####   
#### If current components are broken:  
#### - either repair them  
#### - or simplify pages to not depend on them until the repo is stable  
####   
#### Priority is BUILD SUCCESS first.  
#### Then preserve as much structure and polish as possible.  
####   
#### DESIGN DIRECTION  
####   
#### Keep the UI coherent:  
#### - black background  
#### - white / silver text  
#### - premium spacing  
#### - refined borders  
#### - monochrome aesthetic  
#### - hackerzart branding  
#### - no childish styles  
#### - no generic template feel if easily avoidable  
####   
#### BUILD-FIRST STRATEGY  
####   
#### This is the order of operations you should follow:  
####   
#### 1. inspect the repo  
#### 2. identify all broken/empty/non-module files  
#### 3. repair layout and root config first  
#### 4. repair all page modules  
#### 5. repair API route modules  
#### 6. repair lib modules and utilities  
#### 7. repair or simplify components  
#### 8. remove or bypass broken imports  
#### 9. ensure package.json scripts are correct  
#### 10. ensure the full app builds  
####   
#### PACKAGE.JSON REQUIREMENTS  
####   
#### If package.json is incomplete or invalid, fix it.  
#### It must include at least:  
#### - dev  
#### - build  
#### - start  
#### - lint (optional but preferred)  
####   
#### Use a normal Next.js script setup.  
####   
#### IMPORT / TYPE SAFETY RULES  
####   
#### - fix broken aliases if any  
#### - keep tsconfig paths correct  
#### - avoid importing from empty files  
#### - avoid circular or dead imports where possible  
#### - remove fragile dependencies that create build failures  
####   
#### EXPECTED OUTPUT  
####   
#### At the end of this pass, the repo should:  
#### - have no empty placeholder modules among referenced files  
#### - have valid exports in all pages/routes/helpers/components  
#### - have a valid app/layout.tsx  
#### - have middleware that compiles  
#### - have working package.json scripts  
#### - be able to run npm run build successfully or be extremely close with only one small remaining issue  
####   
#### FINAL INSTRUCTION  
####   
#### Be aggressive and comprehensive.  
#### Do not fix only the current failing file.  
#### Audit and fix the whole repo in one pass so we stop getting one-at-a-time “is not a module” errors.  
#### Preserve good existing code where reasonable, but prioritize a stable, coherent, buildable codebase.

```typescript
  style?: string
  width?: number

@@@@%+-                                            -+%@
```

middleware.ts
```typescript
<<<<<<< SEARCH
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'

const PROTECTED_PREFIXES = ['/dashboard']
const AUTH_PAGES = ['/login', '/signup']

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl

  const isProtected = PROTECTED_PREFIXES.some(
    (prefix) => pathname === prefix || pathname.startsWith(`${prefix}/`)
  )

  if (!isProtected) {
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  const hasSupabaseEnv =
    Boolean(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL) &&
    Boolean(process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY)

  if (!hasSupabaseEnv) {
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  const hasSbAccess =
    request.cookies.has('sb-access-token') ||
    request.cookies.has('sb-access-token.0') ||
    request.cookies
      .getAll()
      .some((cookie) => cookie.name.startsWith('sb-') && cookie.name.endsWith('-auth-token'))

  if (!hasSbAccess) {
    const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
    loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', pathname)
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
  }

  if (AUTH_PAGES.includes(pathname)) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/dashboard', request.url))
  }

  return NextResponse.next()
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
=======
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl

  // Redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes
  if (pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
    const hasAuthToken = request.cookies.has('sb-access-token')
    if (!hasAuthToken) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', pathname)
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.next()
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
```

```typescript
export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response })

  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

  // Redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes
  if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
    return NextResponse.redirect(new URL('/login', request.url))
  }

  return response
}

import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/auth-helpers-nextjs'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response })

  const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

  // Redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes
  if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
    const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
    loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', request.nextUrl.pathname)
    return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
  }

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const { pathname } = request.nextUrl

  // Redirect unauthenticated users from protected routes
  if (pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
    const hasAuthToken = request.cookies.has('sb-access-token')
    if (!hasAuthToken) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', pathname)
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
    }
  }

  return NextResponse.next()
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
=======
import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  
  try {
    const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response })
    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

    if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', request.nextUrl.pathname)
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Middleware error:', error)
  }

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
```

```typescript
import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  
  try {
    const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ req: request, res: response })
    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

    if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', request.nextUrl.pathname)
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Middleware error:', error)
  }

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
=======
import { createMiddlewareClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse } from 'next/server'
import type { NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const response = NextResponse.next()
  
  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) {
    console.warn('Supabase env vars not found - auth disabled')
    return response
  }

  try {
    const supabase = createMiddlewareClient({ request, response })
    const { data: { session } } = await supabase.auth.getSession()

    if (!session && request.nextUrl.pathname.startsWith('/dashboard')) {
      const loginUrl = new URL('/login', request.url)
      loginUrl.searchParams.set('redirectedFrom', request.nextUrl.pathname)
      return NextResponse.redirect(loginUrl)
    }
  } catch (error) {
    console.error('Middleware error:', error)
  }

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
  unstable_allowDynamic: ['/node_modules/@supabase/**'],
}
```

```typescript
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'
import { Database } from '@/lib/types'

export const createServerSupabaseClient = () => {
  const cookieStore = cookies()

  if (!process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL || !process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY) {
    throw new Error('Missing Supabase env vars')
  }

  return createServerClient<Database>(
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL,
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY,
    {           
      cookies: {
        get(name: string) {
          return cookieStore.get(name)?.value
        },
        set(name: string, value: string, options) {
          cookieStore.set({ name, value, ...options })
        },
        remove(name: string, options) {
          cookieStore.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
        }
      }
    }
  )
}
```

```typescript
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export async function createClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    throw new Error(
      'Missing NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY or NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY'
    )
  }

  const cookieStore = await cookies()

  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return cookieStore.getAll()
      },
      setAll(
        cookiesToSet: Array<{
          name: string
          value: string
          options: CookieOptions
        }>
      ) {
        try {
          cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
            cookieStore.set(name, value, options)
          })
        } catch {
          // Server Components may not be allowed to write cookies here.
          // Middleware should handle session refresh when needed.
        }
      },
    },
  })
}

import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { cookies } from 'next/headers'

export function createClient() {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    console.warn('Supabase URL or key not found - using mock client')
    return {
      auth: {
        getUser: () => Promise.resolve({ data: { user: null } }),
      },
    } as unknown as ReturnType<typeof createServerClient>
  }

  const cookieStore = cookies()

  return createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      get(name: string) {
        return cookieStore.get(name)?.value
      },
      set(name: string, value: string, options: CookieOptions) {
        try {
          cookieStore.set({ name, value, ...options })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to set cookie:', error)
        }
      },
      remove(name: string, options: CookieOptions) {
        try {
          cookieStore.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
        } catch (error) {
          console.error('Failed to remove cookie:', error)
        }
      },
    },
  })
}
```

```typescript
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    return NextResponse.next({ request })
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request })

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return request.cookies.getAll()
      },
      setAll(
        cookiesToSet: Array<{
          name: string
          value: string
          options: CookieOptions
        }>
      ) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => {
          request.cookies.set(name, value)
        })

        response = NextResponse.next({ request })

        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options)
        })
      },
    },
  })

  await supabase.auth.getUser()

  return response
}
=======
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'

export async function updateSession(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    return NextResponse.next({ request })
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request })

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      get(name: string) {
        return request.cookies.get(name)?.value
      },
      set(name: string, value: string, options: CookieOptions) {
        request.cookies.set({ name, value, ...options })
        response.cookies.set({ name, value, ...options })
      },
      remove(name: string, options: CookieOptions) {
        request.cookies.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
        response.cookies.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
      },
    },
  })

  await supabase.auth.getUser()

  return response
}
```

```typescript
import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { createServerClient, type CookieOptions } from '@supabase/ssr'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    return NextResponse.next({ request })
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next({ request })

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      getAll() {
        return request.cookies.getAll()
      },
      setAll(
        cookiesToSet: Array<{
          name: string
          value: string
          options: CookieOptions
        }>
      ) {
        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value }) => {
          request.cookies.set(name, value)
        })

        response = NextResponse.next({ request })

        cookiesToSet.forEach(({ name, value, options }) => {
          response.cookies.set(name, value, options)
        })
      },
    },
  })

  await supabase.auth.getUser()

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}

import { NextResponse, type NextRequest } from 'next/server'
import { createServerClient } from '@supabase/ssr'

export const runtime = 'edge'

export async function middleware(request: NextRequest) {
  const url = process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
  const key =
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_PUBLISHABLE_KEY ||
    process.env.NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY

  if (!url || !key) {
    return NextResponse.next()
  }

  let response = NextResponse.next()

  const supabase = createServerClient(url, key, {
    cookies: {
      get(name: string) {
        return request.cookies.get(name)?.value
      },
      set(name: string, value: string, options: any) {
        request.cookies.set({ name, value, ...options })
        response.cookies.set({ name, value, ...options })
      },
      remove(name: string, options: any) {
        request.cookies.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
        response.cookies.set({ name, value: '', ...options })
      },
    },
  })

  await supabase.auth.getUser()

  return response
}

export const config = {
  matcher: ['/dashboard/:path*'],
}
```
